main_text.l: רָקַר Salire, Saltare, Subfilire. Pihe' רֻקַּר Idem. Hiphil הִרְקִיד Subfilire fecit.
רָקַח Condire, Conficere, Miscere unguenta vel condimenta. Pyhal Part. מְרֻקָּחִים Condita, Confecta. Hiphil הִרְקִיחַ Confecit condimenta.
רַקָּח m. Unguentarius, Apothecarius: plur. רַקָּחוֹת & רַקָּחִים.
מִרְקַחַת, מִרְקָחָה & רִקְחָה f. Conditura, Unguentum, Pigmentum, Unguentatio.
רָקַם Acupingere. Pyhal רֻקַּם Artificiosè confici vel effigiari.
רִקְמָה f. Acupictum, Opus Phrygionicum: duale רִקְמָתַיִם Bis Phrygionicum, utraque parte figuratum.
רָקַע Expandit: Plaufit, Percussit. Pihel רִקַּע Diduxit, Expandit. Pyhal Partic. מְרֻקָּע Diductum. Hiphil הִרְקִיעַ Expandit.

page.notes: The Hebrew and Greek-free entries are transcribed as far as legible; vocalisation of several words is uncertain and some forms in the scan are faint. Marginal text: none. The bottom-right "רקק" is a catchword-like line and is treated as such.
